additional_field_meanings.payload_bytes: Actual application bytes, not encoded UART characters or hardware/API transfer chunk. Framing, parity/start/stop and electrical path remain separate, no65535 global cap.

scope: Every exported UART field individually reviewed. Own clock/framing/peer/FIFO/flow/electrical qualification, industry neutral, no generic115200/CAN/gateway fallback.

Distinct identified PIC24H and LPC24xx framing/reset/divider profiles; fractionally occupied stop time, parity overhead and actual baud from real peripheral clock verified. Reset5bit versus8bit framing are conditional suggestions only.

Explicit whole encoded serialization, aggregate gaps/flow blocking, peer oscillator tolerance, FIFO service and independent whole path/function deadline/freshness. USART synchronous modes require independently registered path.

No normative minimum UART baud exists independently of device clock/divider. Only source-defined register framing and divider-mode proposals, no invented oscillator/actual baud/peer tolerance/capacity facts.
not_certified: Selected controller rules and own parameter relationships, not all UART peripherals, synchronous USART standards, complete UART driver/wire executor or electrical certification. Runtime capacity MODEL_MISSING.
